source.name: Venezia FC, 'Cynar Spritz rinnova il suo impegno accanto al Venezia FC e lancia un nuovo capitolo di "Contro il logorio della vita moderna"'
source.quote: Cynar si riconferma Main Sponsor del Venezia FC anche per la nuova stagione
source.note: Italian for: 'Cynar confirms itself again as Main Sponsor of Venezia FC for the new season'. The club names Main Sponsor Cynar Spritz as the front-of-shirt sponsor on its match jerseys, e.g. 'VENEZIA FC PRESENTA LA MAGLIA AWAY 26/27' (veneziafc.it, 14/08/2026): 'è presente lo sponsor di maglia Cynar Spritz sul fronte'.

source.name: Venezia FC, 'PokerStarsNews è partner ufficiale di Venezia FC'
source.quote: Il logo di PokerStarsNews sarà presente sulle maniche delle maglie da gioco della Prima Squadra Maschile del Club Arancioneroverde durante le partite di Serie A Enilive e Coppa Italia Frecciarossa 2026/2027.
source.note: Italian for: 'The PokerStarsNews logo will be on the sleeves of the men's first team's match shirts during 2026/27 Serie A Enilive and Coppa Italia Frecciarossa matches. PokerStarsNews becomes Official Sleeve Partner of the club.'

source.name: Venezia FC, 'Venezia FC and GWM announce their partnership'
source.quote: Under the agreement, GWM becomes the Official Automotive Sponsor and Official Back Sponsor of Venezia FC for the 2026/27 season. The GWM logo will appear on the back of the First Team's official match shirt

summary: NOCTA home shirt: Cynar Spritz on the front (Main Sponsor, renewed August 2026), PokerStarsNews on the sleeve, GWM on the back. Kit-launch reports show no shorts sponsor; the club announced no patch sponsor.
